主要内容: CoreLogic, a leading provider of information, analytics, and business services, announced it will release its third quarter 2012 financial results after the market close on Wednesday, October 24, 2012. The company will host a live webcast and conference call on Thursday, October 25, 2012, at 8:00 a.m. Pacific time to discuss these results. The press release and financial information will be posted on the CoreLogic investor website. The company also provided dial-in numbers for participants and a replay of the webcast for 30 days. CoreLogic is known for its comprehensive U.S. real estate, mortgage, and credit reporting services, with over one million users relying on its data for risk assessment and business decisions. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include CoreLogic (CLGX).
